classification_principle: Select the most specific incident category directly supported by the available evidence. Where no specific technical category is established, classify according to the dominant service symptom.

categories.name: Service Unavailability
categories.definition: Complete or near-complete inability to access a service or essential service function where the evidence does not support a more specific technical category.
include_indicators: all or nearly all requests failing

categories.name: Performance Degradation
categories.definition: A service remains available but operates materially below its expected level of latency, throughput, capacity or reliability.
include_indicators: service degradation while core functionality remains available
exclude_when: essential service function is completely unavailable

categories.name: Application Failure
categories.definition: A failure directly associated with application code, runtime, internal processing logic, software deployment or application-level execution.
exclude_when: the application is only displaying symptoms of a confirmed infrastructure or network failure
an external or internal dependency is directly responsible
invalid or missing configuration is directly responsible
only a general outage symptom is available

categories.name: Infrastructure or Network Failure
categories.definition: A failure directly associated with compute, storage, host, platform, load-balancing, DNS, routing, firewall or network-connectivity components.
exclude_when: an external service dependency is directly responsible
invalid credentials, certificates or application settings are directly responsible
only a general service symptom is available

categories.name: Dependency or Configuration Failure
categories.definition: A failure directly associated with an internal or external dependency, or with incorrect, missing, expired or incompatible configuration.
exclude_when: underlying infrastructure or networking is directly responsible
only a general outage or degradation symptom is available

decision_rules.rule: Use the most specific technical category directly supported by the incident evidence.
If no specific technical category is supported, use Service Unavailability or Performance Degradation according to the dominant service symptom.
Assign one primary category and identify ambiguity or missing evidence separately.
Do not infer a confirmed root cause from symptoms alone.
Do not determine category from severity.
Use the affected-area field to identify the specific service, component or technical domain.
